notes: Faster canvas on large takeoffs, plus mark duplication and clearer layer tools.

features: Ctrl+drag a mark to duplicate it and place the copy
Add to layer: draw another layer mark beside the selected marks at small/same/large size
Highlight now blinks until clicked again instead of stopping after a few seconds
New layers never reuse a colour already in use
fixes: Much faster panning and zooming on takeoffs with thousands of marks
Selection action box no longer grows unusably long when a job has dozens of layers
Dragging a mark can no longer leave the drawing out of sync with the counted data
